subject: Post-call recap: activation clearance & billing trigger options
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@studiox.ai>; Procurement <procurement@studiox.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: activation clearance & billing trigger options

Hi Sophie / StudioX procurement team — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before legal/procurement dives in.

Summary of what we discussed:
- StudioX wants to run a 30-day pilot focused on embeddings + search traffic (not full chat) to validate relevance improvements.
- Preferred procurement path: prefer a PO-based flow but evaluating AWS Marketplace for consolidated billing long-term.
- Success metrics: >80% improvement in top-3 retrieval precision on pilot queries; consistent peak throughput of ~500 embeddings/day; <200ms median response for search queries.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Please confirm whether procurement requires a signed MSA or whether the sample MPA in the attached will suffice to start (we shared a sample earlier).
2) If PO path: what is the procurement lead time and expected PO issuance date? (we typically need PO number to turn on start-of-billing if invoicing).
3) Marketplace interest: if you want to go through AWS Marketplace, confirm the account owner / marketplace contact. That route adds ~2 weeks for listing & approval.

Attachments: purchase-ops-checklist.xlsx (procurement fields we need), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (short SLA + data-handling summary).

Proposed next steps:
- If PO route: you send PO -> we provision dedicated trial entitlement -> billing starts on the confirmed start date tied to PO or milestone.
- If Marketplace: we can provision a coupon/offer to start the pilot immediately but billing will flow through the Marketplace once the listing is active.

Can you confirm procurement preferences and an approximate earliest PO date? If useful, happy to run a short 15-min walk-through of the paperwork with your procurement lead.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Carter <sophie@studiox.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: activation clearance & billing trigger options

Thanks Kim — appreciate the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

1) Procurement path: StudioX prefers to start with an internal PO (card billing is OK for small pilots but procurement wants invoice/PO for pilots > $10k). We are also interested in Marketplace if it reduces our internal chargeback complexity.
2) Docs: procurement needs either an MSA or a short SOW + payment terms (Net30). The sample MPA you referenced looks OK but legal may request minor redlines.
3) Timeline: Our procurement team says a PO can be issued within 7–12 business days once legal signs off on the SOW. I expect a PO by May 28 at the latest if we move quickly.

Success criteria (as requested):
- Target: 500 embeddings/day average, up to 1,200/day at peak testing.
- Token budget: ~150k tokens/month for search/tuning traces.
- Subjective: Product team should see a measurable lift in search click-through within 2 weeks.

Would appreciate a short doc that maps the billing start to PO issuance vs. milestone (for internal gating). Also can you confirm any minimum billing commitment or cancel window post-trial?

Best,
Sophie Carter
Head of Product, StudioX.ai
S: +1 (212) 555-0119
Procurement: procurement@studiox.ai

Hi Sophie — jumping in with the commercial options and some clarifications on billing triggers.

Commercial paths (short list):
1) PO -> Redwood invoice (Net30)
   - We require a PO number to start invoiced billing. Trial entitlement can be provisioned immediately; billing moves to invoice when you confirm the PO start date. No minimum beyond trial usage unless you sign a reserved capacity deal.
2) Card -> Self-serve / immediate start
   - Faster but procurement rarely uses for pilots >$10k. Billing starts on first charge.
3) Marketplace (AWS) -> consolidated chargeback
   - Adds ~10–14 calendar days for listing approval. We can give a promotional coupon to start the pilot right away, then switch billing to Marketplace when the listing is live.

Trial-to-paid gating and options for billing start:
- Option A: Billing starts on PO issuance date. We provision trial entitlement now; once PO number received we enable invoice billing and charge from the PO start date you select.
- Option B: Billing starts on go-live milestone (e.g., first production request or user acceptance sign-off). We can automate start via a signed SOW or a signed acceptance form.
- Option C: Delayed billing with prepaid credit: you pay a one-time credit (card or wire) to cover the trial; any overage is invoiced.

Operational asks we need to provision:
- Point of contact for procurement & legal (name/email)
- Billing contact for invoice distribution
- PO number (if available) and preferred invoice schedule (monthly/quarterly)

I attached the purchase-ops-checklist.xlsx and a short sample MPA for legal. Also attached is the SLA summary for procurement.

Happy to join a call with your procurement lead next week to run the paperwork.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Sophie Carter <sophie@studiox.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: activation clearance & billing trigger options

Appreciate the detail Marcus — a few confirmations from procurement/legal here: 

- Procurement prefers Option A (billing tied to PO issuance). We will issue a PO and want billing to begin on the PO start date.
- Legal will sign the short SOW with minor redlines; they do not require a full MSA for this pilot. We need Net30 terms.
- Invoice cadence: monthly preferred.
- Marketplace: low priority for the pilot; we’ll revisit after successful pilot.

PO ETA: procurement expects to deliver a PO by Friday, 28 May (pending final SOW sign-off).

Success criteria reaffirmed: 2-week signal of improved search CTR, and sustained embeddings throughput (500/day). If we see those two things in the 30-day window we’ll convert to an initial paid agreement.

A couple final asks: 
1) Can Redwood set the billing start to the PO effective date (we will include that date on the PO)?
2) What is the earliest possible invoice generation date after we send the PO?

Thanks — I’ll loop in our procurement lead separately if helpful.

Best,
Sophie

Thanks Sophie — great to have clarity. Confirming next steps & our operational timeline so procurement has what it needs: 

1) Billing start: we will set billing to the PO effective date you place on the PO. Once we receive the PO number and effective date, we will enable invoice billing and generate the first invoice on the next monthly cycle consistent with Net30 terms.

2) Earliest invoice generation: in practical terms we can generate the first invoice within 3 business days of receiving the PO and the signed SOW; invoice due Net30 from invoice date. If you need invoice date to match the PO effective date for internal chargeback, include that effective date on the PO and we will honor it for the first invoice.

3) No minimum commitment required to start the pilot. If you prefer a reserved capacity commitment later, we can discuss add-ons.

4) Operational handoff: please send the PO to billing@redwood.com and copy procurement@redwood.com. We will provision trial entitlement upon receipt of PO number and SOW signature.

5) Can we schedule a 20-minute procurement walk-through with your lead on Monday, May 31 (10am PT)? Marcus and I can join. If that works, please share the procurement lead's calendar invite.

Thanks again — excited to get StudioX live.

—
